description: The Sentinels is a team driven by curiosity, creativity, and a passion for innovation. We bring together diverse perspectives, scientific thinking, and problem-solving skills to explore new possibilities. We believe in questioning the ordinary, challenging limitations, and transforming ideas into practical solutions that create a meaningful impact.
summary:
KISAN X is an AI-powered agricultural intelligence platform designed to support Indian farmers through NASA Earth observation data, climate science, and intelligent digital tools.

Its core system, KRISHIQ, provides a farmer-focused agricultural knowledge interface. The platform combines NASA POWER climate data, NASA GIBS satellite imagery, and other Earth-data sources to provide environmental context for agricultural decision-making.

Key capabilities include:

• Farm profiles and digital field-boundary mapping.
• NASA POWER climate observations and historical climate analysis.
• Satellite imagery through NASA GIBS.
• A multi-source Earth observation data hub.
• Crop rotation comparisons and what-if simulations.
• Agricultural knowledge assistance through KRISHIQ.
• Farm reports and a responsive web application.

Built using Python, FastAPI, JavaScript, and modern web technologies, KISAN X connects scientific environmental datasets with practical agricultural workflows.

NASA datasets are treated as environmental context rather than direct farm measurements. The current version is a hackathon prototype, with further agronomic validation, AI integration, and field testing planned.

Our vision is to bridge space technology and Indian agriculture, making scientific intelligence more accessible to farmers and supporting sustainable, climate-resilient farming.
